sloka: विशुद्ध वंश अभिजना अग्र हस्तःतेजो मदः संस्थित दोर्??? विषाणः ।उदीक्षितुम् रावण न इह युक्तःस संयुगे राघव गन्धि हस्ती ॥३-३१-४६॥
transliteration: viśuddha vaṁśa abhijanā agra hastaḥtejo madaḥ saṁsthita dor??? viṣāṇaḥ ।udīkṣitum rāvaṇa na iha yuktaḥsa saṁyuge rāghava gandhi hastī ॥3-31-46॥

translations.english: Rama is like a mighty tusker. His pure and high birth is his trunk. His wellbuilt and strong arms are his tusks. His brilliance in his ichor. Nobody can face this intoxicated elephant in battle.
